text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/repository.py:13:deprecated-method"], "search": "    return Customer.from_orm(record)", "replace": "    return Customer.model_validate(record, from_attributes=True)", "explanation": "Pydantic V2 deprecates BaseModel.from_orm() in favor of model_validate(). Per the migration guide, model_validate is the replacement for ORM-style loading when from_attributes=True is set. Passing from_attributes=True at the call site keeps the attribute-based loading of the SimpleNamespace record working regardless of Customer's model_config. The signature model_validate(obj, *, strict=None, from_attributes=None, context=None) supports this keyword. No import changes are needed because Customer is already imported."}], "notes": "Only one finding in app/repository.py (line 13, from_orm). The edit replaces it with model_validate(record, from_attributes=True), which is the V2 replacement the guide describes. The rest of the file has no V1 APIs: make_record uses SimpleNamespace only, and the import of Customer is still used, so no import changes are needed. I did not modify app/models.py to add from_attributes to Customer's config, since that file is outside this edit's scope and the call-site flag is sufficient on its own."}
